claim_boundary: Frozen 160-row finite-analogue discovery search only. It proves no CRR compatibility/incompatibility statement, extremizer, saturation theorem, density estimate, or short-interval result. No candidate has been evaluated.

finite_surrogate.rational_sum: R_W(x)=sum_{t in W} exp(2*pi*i*t*x), x in [0,1]

mutation.acceptance: 16-node/mode-8 proxy increases by at least 2^-40; otherwise reject
mutation.operation: one-for-one W swap with forward cyclic collision repair; recompute the family b rule from the same W

predecessor.continuing_authorization: This separate preregistration supplies the formerly missing finite families/ranges/seed/cap/retention details; it does not alter formalization-v2 claims.

quadrature_and_cubic.farey_partition: all reduced fractions in [0,1] of denominator <=Q, midpoint cells, Gauss-Legendre mapped cellwise

retention.failed_row_rule: Every one of the 160 scheduled rows is retained exactly once. No parameter-changing retry is permitted. After a global cap, the active row is RESOURCE_CAP and all unstarted rows are GLOBAL_CAP_UNREACHED.
retention.recognition_ball: centre=384-bit value; radius=2*max(|384-bit-256-bit|,2^-256*(1+|centre|)); not a rigorous enclosure

thresholds.recognition_radius: every retained final value has empirical recognition-ball radius < 10^(-30)*N^(7/10)

schedule.rng: SplitMix64 unsigned 64-bit wraparound; each row uses the next master-stream output as its fresh row seed
